Replies.Text:
The mod runs in the plugin engine's sandbox: no Node, no sockets to listen on. It can fetch out over HTTP ($.http.fetch), write files ($.fs.write) and start a host process ($.process.spawn). So the server has to be a separate Node + Express process, and the mod a publisher that posts each event to it.

Two questions. (1) Who starts the server: the mod, on session.start, when a health check on the port fails (the server ships in the plugin folder, so the mod knows where it is), or you, by hand, with the mod only posting and going quiet when nobody answers? Recommendation: the mod starts it when it is not running, and it keeps running after the session ends so the web page stays up. (2) Address: 127.0.0.1 on a fixed default port, settable in a config file. Recommendation: port 3600, configured in ~/.claudit/config.json, with the plugin's userConfig able to override it.

Proposal for each event: session id, agent id (subagent calls carry their own), tool name, a one-line summary (Bash: its description; file tools: the path; search tools: the pattern; others: the tool name alone), start time, end time, duration, and the outcome (done, denied, failed). Not carried in v1: the full input and the tool's output, which can be large and can hold secrets; a later setting can turn them on. Replies.Text:
Proposed API, all on the server, bound to 127.0.0.1 with no auth in v1:

- POST /api/events: the mod posts one event (or a batch) here.
- GET /api/live: the live stream as Server-Sent Events, every event of every session as it arrives, with an optional ?session= filter.
- GET /api/sessions: the sessions in the archive, newest first, with their summaries.
- GET /api/sessions/<id>: one session's events.
- GET /api/health: for the mod's start-up check.

Streaming as SSE rather than WebSockets: it is plain HTTP, needs no dependency, and the browser's EventSource reconnects by itself. Agreed, or do you want WebSockets?

Replies.Text:
**Build log: Claudit Design I**, built by Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) as Claude-CLI.

**What was built**

The plugin in two parts, as the plan says, plus the web UI, tests and docs. The repo is W:/code-projects/orgs/mchiver/claudit.git; nothing is committed yet.

- The mod: `hooks/register.js` (ES module, plain JavaScript) with `hooks/hooks.json` and the manifest `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (plugin option `port`, default 0 = use the config file). It hooks session.start (registers /claudit, reads the switch from the engine store, reads ~/.claudit/config.json, checks the health route, starts the server when nothing answers, posts the session start mark), tool.call (one event per call: session, agent, tool, one-line summary, start, end, duration, outcome; posted once as running and once finished; status line with the call in flight, its elapsed time ticking each second, and the turn's count), turn.complete (the block beneath the answer: a header with session and count, then "hh:mm:ss  1.2s  Bash  description" per call; nothing on a turn without calls; off when config `feedback` is false), session.end (the end mark), and command.run for /claudit on | off | status (the switch kept in the engine's cross-session store). The pure formatting is in `hooks/format.js`.
- The server: `server/server.js` (start-up, prune at start and daily), `server/app.js` (Express: POST /api/events, GET /api/live as Server-Sent Events with ?session=, GET /api/sessions, GET /api/sessions/<id>, GET /api/health, and the static web UI), `server/archive.js` (JSON Lines per session under `<archive>/<yyyy-mm-dd>/`, a summary JSON beside it, retention by day folder), `server/live.js` (the SSE hub with heartbeats), `server/config.js` (defaults, ~/.claudit/config.json, command line). `server/launch.js` starts the server detached with its output in ~/.claudit/server.log, so it outlives the session: the mod runs it through the engine's process runner because a child spawned by the engine itself dies with the module.
- The web UI: `public/index.html`, `public/app.js` (the module, the State service, filters), `public/app.css`, and components under `public/components/`: claudit-app, title-bar (live dot, session count, theme toggle, small/normal/large), session-list (live on top, archived below; emits claudit:select), event-list (the selected session's events, running row highlighted, denied and failed tinted, auto-scroll at the bottom). AngularJS 1.8.3 and Bootstrap 5.3.3 from cdnjs; Express is the only npm dependency.
- Docs: README.md (use, config, API), .guides/launch-server.md, .definitions/event.md and session.md. package.json with `npm start` and `npm test`.

**How it was checked**

- `npm test` (node --test): 15 tests, all pass. hooks/format.test.js covers the summary per tool, outcomes, clock, duration, the status line and the block. server/archive.test.js covers append (running calls live only), summaries, reading back, listing newest first, retention and refusal of an event without a session. server/app.test.js starts a server on a free port with a temporary archive and checks health, posting events, the sessions routes, a 404, a 400, the SSE stream with a session filter, and that the web page is served.
- `claude plugin validate .` passes. It lists the five hooks and the engine calls the module makes ($.clock.now, $.command.register, $.env.get, $.fs.read, $.http.fetch, $.process.run, $.session.id, $.store.get/set, $.ui.log, $.ui.status). Two warnings, neither a fault: no plugin icon, and CLAUDE.md at the root is not plugin context.
- Launcher smoke test on a spare port 3611: started detached, answered health, took an event, listed it, served the page; then stopped.
- End to end: `claude --plugin-dir . -p "/claudit status"`. The mod loaded, found nothing on 3600, started the server detached, and recorded the whole headless session: the start mark, 11 tool calls (Read, Grep, Bash, PowerShell, Glob with their summaries, durations and outcomes, the shell calls failed as -p denied them) and the end mark; the session is in ~/.claudit/archive/2026-10-21/ and on the web page.

**Things to know**

- That server is still running on http://127.0.0.1:3600 with the web page up; it will stay up until you stop it (see .guides/launch-server.md).
- In the headless run the prompt "/claudit status" went to the model rather than to the command: a `-p` run reads its prompt before session.start registers the command. In an interactive session the command is registered at start and answers itself. I have not run an interactive session from here; that is the one check left to you: `claude --plugin-dir W:/code-projects/orgs/mchiver/claudit.git`, then a few tool calls, then /claudit status.
- The summary covers Bash, PowerShell, Read, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, MultiEdit, Grep, Glob, Agent, Task, WebFetch, WebSearch and Skill; any other tool shows its name.
- A `package-lock.json` was written by npm install; it goes in the commit unless you say otherwise. `.consensus/` is not ignored.
